name: runbook-compiler-monorepo
description: Runbook Compiler reference implementation and RunbookBench research suite

scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/*" run build
scripts.local:compile: pnpm --filter @runbook/compiler build && mkdir -p .local && node packages/compiler/dist/cli.js compile fixtures/runbooks/acme-ingestion-recovery.md --plan fixtures/compile-plans/acme-ingestion-recovery.json --manifest fixtures/manifests/acme-operations.json --output .local/acme-ingestion-recovery.rbir.json
scripts.local:bench: pnpm --filter @runbook/bench build && node packages/bench/dist/cli.js validate fixtures/bench-corpus && node packages/bench/dist/cli.js eval fixtures/bench-corpus --candidates fixtures/bench-candidates --manifest fixtures/manifests/acme-operations.json
scripts.local:smoke: pnpm --filter @runbook/compiler build && pnpm --filter @runbook/broker build && pnpm --filter @runbook/control build && pnpm --filter @runbook/acme-worker build && node scripts/local-smoke.mjs
scripts.local:http-smoke: pnpm --filter @runbook/compiler build && pnpm --filter @runbook/broker build && pnpm --filter @runbook/control build && pnpm --filter @runbook/acme-worker build && node scripts/local-http-orchestration-smoke.mjs
